description: This Java class manages the selection and connection of a MIDI output port to a specified destination device and port, providing UI interactions and connection handling for MIDI hardware within an Android application.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
classes.description: Handles the selection and connection of MIDI output ports to input ports on MIDI devices, with UI callback integration.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MIDI port connection selector with target device info and port index.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a MIDI port is selected from UI, establishing a connection to the specified device port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the current MIDI port connection and releases resources.

methods.name: setConnectedListener
methods.description: Sets a callback listener that is notified when ports are successfully connected.
